title_zh: 恢复编辑器的正常输入方式

scenario.label_zh: 排查键盘导致的覆盖输入
scenario.goal_zh: 确认误触按键造成覆盖输入，关闭该功能并实际验证文字恢复正常

context_zh: 员工多拉通过内部支持电话请本帮助检查一个编辑器的输入问题。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Dora
sentences.text: Is this IT? Whenever I type, the next letter disappears.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Yes, I can help. Which keys did you press just before it started?

sentences.speaker: Dora
sentences.text: I dropped a notebook on the keyboard. Now I have made a mess of this sentence.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: I can see the screen you shared. This editor is in overwrite mode.

sentences.speaker: Dora
sentences.text: What is the function of the key labelled Insert? I think the notebook hit that one.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: In this editor, it switches overwrite mode on and off. Press it once, then undo the damaged sentence.

sentences.speaker: Dora
sentences.text: The sentence is back. I will try adding a word in the middle.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Does the following text stay there now?

sentences.speaker: Dora
sentences.text: Yes, it moves along instead of disappearing. That has fixed it. Thank you.

targets.sense_zh: 信息技术部门或信息技术支持
